shaSeparation.note: Per SKYLINE 2026-06-28 Continuous Delivery Master Directive, every checkpoint manifest preserves the three-way SHA separation. reviewedCandidateSha is the exact SHA Codex C6 review was issued against; manifestCommitSha is this manifest's own commit; integrationSha is the post-merge Train HEAD. Substituting one for another is a tier violation.
shaSeparation.reviewedCandidateNote: Filled when the C6 adversarial Codex review issues PASS. Until then, null is the honest value — Codex has not yet been run on a candidate SHA.
shaSeparation.manifestCommitNote: Filled by a follow-up evidence-anchoring commit after integrationSha is known; mirrors the C5R convention.
shaSeparation.integrationNote: Filled only after the C6 branch-to-branch PR merges into feat/r3.0-integrated-delivery AND the Train target-context trusted-verification PASSes at that integration HEAD.

tests.evidenceTier: TIER 3 — Claude-verified at the C6 branch HEAD; CI re-run on integrationSha is the authority for the Train target context.

builderSteps: 1. validate result is shaped like a C5 service output (status + sign + identity)
2. validate association block (caseId / sessionId / track / layout / basis / direction)
4. allowlist payload — only the directive-named fields
5. rebuild plain object from scratch — never spread the caller's result
6. apply bounded item caps + per-string + total UTF-8 byte caps (envelope contract)
exportContractSurface.staleResultGuard: result.identity { caseId, sessionId } MUST match association.{caseId, sessionId}; mismatch fails closed with CROSS_CASE_COMPARISON_UNSUPPORTED / CROSS_SESSION_COMPARISON_UNSUPPORTED.
exportContractSurface.phaseGatePreservation: PHASE_SCOPE_METRICS (entry/mid/exit_delta) are reported metricAvailability:false in the export while phase_boundary_contract.enabled is false (F6 governance gate carried from CP1R).

note: C6 Comparison Export. Adds ONE production capability (comparison_export_present) backed by renderer/js/r3-0c-comparison-export.js. The service is a closed-allowlist gateway: it validates input authority, rebuilds a plain payload from explicit allowlist fields (never spreads the caller's result), invokes contracts/r3.0c/comparison-export-contract.js for envelope construction + bounds, then JSON.serialize → parse → re-validate for deterministic round-trip equivalence. Stale-result guard: result.identity must match association. F6 governance gate preserved: phase metrics report metricAvailability:false until phase_boundary_contract.enabled becomes true. Blocked-result export contains only status / reasonCodes / limitations / identity / nextValidationAction — no fabricated metrics, no raw telemetry, no per-sample arrays, no exotic objects. No UI activation. No feature-registry change. C6 adversarial Codex review + Train target-context CI will fill the null SHA / verdict / artifact fields per the SHA-separation discipline before integration.
